scorecard.behavior: A local agent-facing recall call retrieves an active rule with statement, lifecycle status, confidence, and resolved citations.
proof: TestServeRecallReturnsRelevantActiveRuleWithResolvedCitations verifies recall returns only the active accepted rule and excludes a candidate rule.
Direct command probe returned relia.recall_result for memory/rules/demo-assessment-active-rule.yaml with citations https://github.com/Clyra-AI/relia-demo-seed/pull/142, /187, and /203.
ServedRuleData and ValidateServedRuleCitations fail closed unless served rule citations are canonical GitHub PR URLs matching provenance PR numbers.

scorecard.behavior: The advisory loop remains non-blocking by default, while an explicitly enabled recurrence gate exits 5 when the threshold trips.
proof: TestBacktestExplicitEnabledGateEvaluatesThreshold verifies gate.enabled=true with a tripped threshold returns ExitGate 5 and does not overwrite the baseline on failure.
Backtest report tests verify the gate is off by default.

Advisory command and workflow tests verify the Action path is advisory-only, writes at most one comment plan, skips unchanged or capped comments, and treats unavailable trusted-base advisory support as a successful skip.

scorecard.behavior: ERR trend compares against a saved baseline and labels stale baselines.
proof: TestCompareBaselineJSONMarksDigestAndWindowMismatchStale verifies stale labels for source digest and window mismatches.
Backtest report tests verify baseline status travels in report diagnostics and command-result data.

scorecard.behavior: Coverage reports active-memory density and no_coverage/out-of-distribution signals for repo-relative paths.
proof: TestServeCoverageLabelsCoveredAndOutOfDistributionPaths verifies covered_risky for a path with an active avoid rule and no_coverage/out_of_distribution for an uncovered path.
serve --paths rejects non-repo-relative explicit path arguments.
Coverage response uses active_memory_rules as its source and includes agent access boundary metadata.

residual_risks: This task provides deterministic local tool-call responses in the existing JSON command-result envelope; a long-running JSON-RPC MCP transport remains outside this bounded worker slice.
Factory lifecycle evidence is intentionally not authored by the task-executor worker.
